About the job
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About Applied AI

Applied AI is Juniper Square's internal-first AI engineering team. We design, build, and run the agents and intelligence layers that help Juniper Square operate in an agentic way, starting with leadership and business-unit needs and built against our own systems of record. We are first-class engineering members of Juniper Square's agent platform team, and we build and deploy the internal projects on top of it, on Juniper Square's AI infrastructure. As the platform matures, our work will extend to clients who use the systems we build.

About your role

We are hiring Applied AI Engineers who can build. You will own delivery end to end: working with internal stakeholders to understand the problem, scoping, designing, building, deploying, and operating what you ship. You sit close to the people who use your work, not behind a ticket queue.

This is an AI-first engineering role. The solutions you build are powered by modern AI, and you will work at the leverage AI-assisted development makes possible, while understanding in depth every system you ship.

The work calls for strong systems design and hands-on full-stack engineering, with enough product judgment to define requirements and make trade-offs that get working software into users' hands quickly. You will operate independently when needed, supported by a world-class team of engineers.

Success is measured by adoption and impact. You own what you build through launch and beyond, iterating on real user feedback and contributing the patterns you develop back to Applied AI's reusable component library.

What you'll do
Partner with internal stakeholders, from the executive team to business units such as sales, finance, HR, and marketing, to find the workflows where custom agents create real leverage
Translate ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, scope, and acceptance criteria
Carry each solution through its full lifecycle, from prototype and stakeholder validation through hardening, deployment, and rollout to production
Design and build agentic systems: retrieval and context design, tool and MCP integration, orchestration, evaluation harnesses, and the observability and cost controls that keep them reliable in production
Design event-driven, scalable systems that ingest and process large volumes of data and documents
Partner with Juniper Square's platform, R&D, and product engineering teams where the work touches core systems
Make engineering trade-offs that hold up under real commitments, finding speed through reuse rather than through shortcuts on reliability, security, or maintainability
Own deployed solutions through adoption, including post-launch support, iteration on user feedback, and ongoing operation
Produce documentation, train users, and manage rollouts to drive adoption
Set the technical bar for less experienced engineers on your projects, and grow toward leading projects of your own, including client-facing work as it develops
Qualifications
5+ years of professional experience shipping production software end to end, with hands-on experience building AI-native applications or agents
Strong systems design skills: you can think out loud and whiteboard a real system, including components, trade-offs, and what you would change
Full-stack engineering capability across data, services, user interfaces, and the infrastructure underneath them
Hands-on infrastructure ownership: deploying and operating applications on a major cloud provider, with working knowledge of containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and production monitoring
Fluency with AI-assisted development, paired with the depth to understand, debug, and defend everything you ship
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs from internal stakeholders into requirements and deliver working software against them
Strong product judgment: defining scope for a first release, prioritizing, and knowing when something is done
Excellent written communication, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues
Potential to work directly with clients as the team's scope grows
Nice to have
Experience in private markets, financial services, or another regulated, data-sensitive domain
Familiarity with application security and data handling practices for sensitive data under contractual and SOC 2 obligations, including multi-tenant isolation
Experience building evaluation and regression testing for non-deterministic systems
Experience with event-driven architectures and large-scale document processing
Client-facing, consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering background
Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary with equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is 165,000-200,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family
Life insurance
Mental wellness coverage
Fertility and growing family support
Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays
Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies
Retirement saving plans
Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home
Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

About the job
Senior Software Engineer, Platform

Team: Platform Engineering

Location: Portland, Oregon. Full time (hybrid)

Salary range: $132,300–$161,700

Unfortunately, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

About CreativeX

CreativeX is building the system of creative control for an AI-first marketing world. As AI rewrites how content is made, evaluated, and distributed, marketers need a foundation they can trust and a way to bring consistency, intelligence, and governance to creative at scale. For over a decade, we’ve powered smarter creative decisions for the world’s biggest brands, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, shipped category-defining products, and proven that creative is the single biggest driver of marketing performance

We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client’s digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance.

This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We’re an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift.

Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data.

Platform Engineering Team

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll own the reliability, performance and scalability of the production infrastructure behind every CreativeX product. You’ll be a part of the Platform Engineering team, which builds the infrastructure, shared services and self-service tools our engineers rely on, and runs the systems that collect, process and serve the ad data and creative scoring our customers depend on.

We’re investing in our core architecture: evolving our data layer, scaling our processing pipelines for higher throughput and automating more of how we process creative assets. You’ll lead the database migrations and rearchitecture work that make this possible, and build the tooling that lets other engineers deploy, test and debug. This is a systems-level role so you’ll write code, but most of your impact will come from how our systems are designed, run, observed and scaled. You enjoy taking a system that works and making it faster, more reliable and easier to run, and this role is an opportunity to shape the platform that CreativeX’s next stage of growth is built on.

What you will do:
Be the owner and go-to expert for the reliability and performance of our production systems
Lead database migrations and rearchitecture projects across teams, from planning and risk assessment through cutover, with minimal disruption to customers
Scale our infrastructure and data processing pipelines to keep pace with growing data volumes and throughput
Build self-service tools and automation that let engineers deploy, test and debug on their own
Maintain and improve staging and development environments, deployment automation and testing infrastructure
Improve observability across our systems, using AI-assisted workflows to cut manual investigation and repetitive operational work
Respond to production incidents and lead post-incident reviews that result in lasting fixes
Collaborate with Information Security, Product and the wider engineering team to keep our systems secure and flag feasibility and scalability risks early
Set and meet reliability and performance targets for the platform
Who you are:
Experience leading a database migration or significant architectural change on a live production system
Deep, hands-on experience with cloud data platforms in production, including performance tuning and query optimisation
A track record of scaling existing web applications and the infrastructure behind them, with a strong grounding in observability, monitoring and alerting
Comfort reading and writing production code, ideally in Ruby on Rails
Day-to-day use of AI tools such as Claude to build workflows and automation, not only as a search engine
Clear communication: you explain technical trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers, and write documentation others can follow
Experience with a major cloud platform like AWS or DigitalOcean; infrastructure as code (e.g. Ansible); Datadog or similar monitoring
Nice to have: High-volume data or media pipelines; internal developer platforms or self-service tooling; working within a formal information security programme
What success looks like

In your first 90 days

You know our production architecture, data layer and deployment pipeline well enough to make changes safely, and you have shipped improvements to production.
You have assessed our current database setup and agreed a plan with engineering leadership for the first major migration or rearchitecture, including risks, sequencing and rollback.
You have delivered at least one reliability or observability improvement that other teams notice, such as fixing a noisy alert or replacing a recurring manual request with a self-service tool.

After one year

You have led at least one major database migration or rearchitecture to completion without unplanned customer-facing downtime.
Our systems handle higher data volumes and pipeline throughput, and reliability and performance are tracked against agreed targets.
Engineers across CreativeX use self-service tooling you built to deploy, test or debug, and wait less on the platform team.

At CreativeX, we encourage applicants of all backgrounds and identities to apply for roles that align with their own interests and career trajectory. If you fit the description above and see yourself in this role, we would love to see your application!

What we Offer:

🍎 Fully paid medical, dental, and vision (US) and Private Medical Insurance and Health Cash Plan (UK)

✈️ Generous time off + bank holidays

📚 Education budget to be used for individual learning experiences or grouped with your team for joint learning

🧘 Annual subscription to Calm and Headspace for your mental wellbeing

🎟 Monthly coaching to talk to a trained professional about career goals, relationships, and personal development

💵 Competitive salary and commission plan including stock options, as we believe that everyone should have a stake in the business

🍼 4-month full pay parenting leave for all employees who have been with the company for one (1) year

🪴 Employee contributions to a 401(k) once they have completed their eligibility period

CreativeX provides equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, CreativeX conducts standard right to work and background checks on all potential employees. This process is designed to verify the accuracy of information provided by candidates and to ensure a safe environment for all employees. Background checks are conducted via a secure third party application and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

About the job

Come join our Engineering team!

High velocity, high intensity, high trust, high bar, high impact, and a will to win.

If that resonates deeply with you, this could be your next career move. We’re seeking someone who leads with humility, pursues audacious goals, and is motivated by meaningful impact on people and the world.

At FutureFit AI, our core mission is to help more people get to better jobs faster and cheaper, with a specific focus on those facing barriers to opportunity. Our work helps resolve the growing issue of economic inequality, ensuring that no one is left behind in the future of work. Our AI-powered platform brings efficiency and insight to workforce development, replacing outdated systems and unlocking human potential at scale.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today.

Important note: Data shows that men typically apply when meeting 3/10 requirements, while women often wait until it’s 10/10. We encourage you to apply if you see a strong (not necessarily perfect) fit.

Our Company

Team: 30 to 50 people across the US and Canada, with main hubs in New York and Toronto
Funding: Built from 0 to 1 with no external capital (a rare feat for tech startups), then raised one round of funding led by JP Morgan, which fueled significant growth

The Opportunity

We’re seeking a Senior Backend Engineer (Integrations & Platform) to build the backbone our platform runs on. You’ll design scalable backend systems that power complex data integrations with government and enterprise partners, remove manual operational work, and help the team move faster with less friction.

This is a build role and an operate role: when a sync fails or a record looks wrong, you can trace it back to the cause and fix it.

Your Role

Our integration footprint has grown quickly, and the most demanding piece is a bidirectional data sync with an external partner that requires sophisticated error handling, async workflows, and operational automation. You’ll start there, then turn what you build into the patterns and infrastructure we use for integration reliability across the platform.

This is hands-on, high-impact work where you’ll see results quickly: fewer production issues, faster support resolution, and systems that scale with confidence.

What You’ll Own

Complex data integrations: Design, build, and maintain deep, bidirectional data integrations with government and enterprise partners, including partners with limited documentation.
Asynchronous workflows: Build reliable async processing using queues, retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency patterns, handling duplicates, missing dependencies, and validation failures defensively.
Operational automation: Eliminate categories of manual support work through backend services, Lambda functions, and internal tools that let non-technical teammates diagnose and resolve issues themselves.
Observability: Implement structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting so issues surface before support tickets do.
Production reliability: Stay close enough to running systems to debug them, including code you did not write.
Reusable patterns: Establish integration standards the rest of the team can build on.
Partner collaboration: Work with external vendors on API changes and coordinated deployments.

Your 30/60/90 Day Plan

At FutureFit AI, we value clarity of purpose and rapid momentum. Here’s what success looks like in your first 90 days:

First 30 Days: Learn and Integrate

Build relationships with the engineering, customer success, and support teams who interact with our integration systems daily
Deep dive into our most complex integration: the bidirectional sync architecture between our platform and external partners (APIs, data models, async workflows, error patterns)
Get hands-on with our debugging tools: MongoDB queries for async job tracking, CloudWatch Logs Insights for distributed tracing, SQL queries for data validation
Ship your first small fixes or improvements: resolve straightforward integration bugs or improve observability in one workflow

Days 31 to 60: Own and Execute

Take ownership of your first major automation initiative: eliminate a category of manual support work
Build and deploy backend services and Lambda functions that reduce manual intervention in the integration pipeline
Implement comprehensive observability (structured logging, metrics, and alerting) so issues surface before support tickets
Work with the support team to validate that your automation eliminates manual work, and identify the next highest-impact opportunity
Document runbooks and create internal tools that empower non-technical team members to diagnose and resolve common issues independently
Collaborate with external partners on any API changes or coordinated deployments your automation needs
Begin identifying patterns and infrastructure that can be reused across other integrations or platform systems

Days 61 to 90: Lead and Amplify

Measure and communicate the impact of your automation: reduction in support tickets, decrease in manual intervention time, improvement in data consistency and error rates
Participate in architectural discussions and planning for other platform initiatives, bringing your expertise in reliability patterns, async workflows, and operational excellence
Mentor other engineers on the patterns and infrastructure you’ve built, establishing yourself as the go-to person for integration reliability
Present a technical deep-dive to the broader engineering team on what you’ve learned and built

Required Experience

5 to 8+ years of senior-level, hands-on experience in backend, platform, or integration engineering, with a focus on building reliable systems for complex external integrations
Strong experience with TypeScript and Node.js
Proven experience building and maintaining complex data integrations at enterprise or government scale (deep data integration work, not only SSO, API configuration, or cloud deployments)
Strong understanding of asynchronous workloads and processing
Experience developing reliable, production-grade backend systems
Strong debugging skills using logs, metrics, and tracing
Proficiency with at least one SQL or NoSQL database in production
Comfort working effectively in a fully remote environment

Bonus Points

AWS experience (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS); Azure experience is transferable
Frontend or full-stack development experience
Experience with financial, banking, or similarly complex data integrations
GraphQL API design, MongoDB or DynamoDB for async state management
Experience with legacy enterprise or government systems
Multi-tenant architecture experience

Our Tech Stack

Languages: TypeScript, Node.js
Architecture: Event-driven (EventBridge, SQS, Lambda)
Data: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redshift
Observability: CloudWatch Logs Insights
Infrastructure: AWS, GitHub Actions for CI/CD

Your Education

Your alma mater isn’t our focus. Your grit, hunger, and drive are. If you learn continuously, tackle challenges head-on, and know your strengths and gaps intimately, you’re our person.

Benefits

Work directly with the founding team
Unlimited PTO
Health care
Career development budget
Technology reimbursement
Flexible schedules built on trust

Location

Remote across the US and Canada. We are open to candidates living anywhere in either country, with at least 5 to 6 hours of daily overlap with our EST-based team required. For candidates living in Toronto, our office is conveniently located at 325 Front St West (a short walk from Union Station), and you are welcome

About the job

Requirements

Must-haves

7+ years of professional experience
Deep and current Microsoft SQL Server administration
Hands-on experience with SQL Server installation and configuration on a self-managed server (EC2 or on-premise), including OS-level work beneath a live production instance
Experience with Windows Server administration, including OS upgrades and migrations
Recently performed SQL Server upgrade, including source and target versions, in-place or side-by-side, and the Windows Server version pairing
Experience with SQL Server high availability (Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering)
Experience with MySQL administration
Experience with AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch)
Proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude) applied to daily work
Prior end-to-end ownership of a production database estate, including assessing an inherited environment and driving it to a measurably better state
Experience setting data standards and reviewing schema and data-access design across application teams
Strong communication skills in both spoken and written English

What makes you stand out

Most recent SQL Server upgrade performed, stated on the profile: source and target versions, in-place or side-by-side, year, and the Windows Server version pairing
Why this role exists:
This position reports into the Platform team and serves as the top technical authority on data for both engineering groups
The pressing need is someone able to jump straight into a time-sensitive OS upgrade ahead of year-end
The broader mandate is bringing the estate to a standard that holds up with customers, auditors, and the insurer
The company was formed through a merger and runs two separate stacks, with no single owner accountable for the estate to date
We're looking for someone motivated to solve this at the root rather than apply a temporary fix, with the mandate to do so

Nice-to-haves

Startup experience
Snowflake administration and development
ETL pipelines and tools (e.g., Rivery, dbt)
Data warehouse design and development
Data lake on S3
BI/analytics tools (e.g., Metabase, QuickSight)
Data governance and data quality practice
SQL Server migration to a managed service
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent

What you will work on

Own the database and data estate end to end: assess what we have, run a time-critical upgrade as the first job, and then set the direction and standards that mature the whole environment
The company is the product of a merger, so we run two stacks — C#/.NET on Microsoft SQL Server, and TypeScript/JavaScript on MySQL — both in AWS
Our SQL Server is BYOL on EC2: we install, configure, and operate it ourselves, an on-premise setup that happens to live in AWS. MySQL runs on RDS

First 90 days

Assess the current estate: inventory, backup and recovery posture, high availability configuration, monitoring and alerting gaps, access model, capacity, and cost.
Produce a written state-of-the-estate and a prioritized remediation plan
Near-term priority
Upgrade the Windows Server OS hosting our production SQL Server estate — Windows Server 2016 → 2022 — across an Always On Availability Group cluster, with no data loss and minimal downtime. Must do before the end of 2026
Then upgrade the SQL Server version from our current SQL Server 2017, and own the recommendation on whether we stay self-managed on EC2 or move to AWS RDS managed SQL Server after the upgrade.
Core ownership
Full ownership of administration, operation,s and optimization for all relational databases: SQL Server (self-managed on EC2) and MySQL (RDS)
Performance tuning, monitoring and alerting, backup and recovery, high availability and failover, security and access management, capacity and cost
Maturing the estate
Define and enforce database standards across the C#/.NET SQL Server and TypeScript/MySQL codebases; act as the technical authority on schema and data-access design for both engineering teams
Own data observability: monitoring, alerting, and capacity forecasting against agreed service levels
Establish backup and DR testing, access governan,ce and change control that stand up to SOC 2 and our cyber insurer
Produce and maintain a data platform roadmap covering both relational stacks, Snowfl,ake and the analytics estate
Set direction for the data engineering team on database matters
Secondary
Snowflake administration, including usage and cost monitoring
Database development — stored procedures, schema design, query optimization
Data warehouse and data engineering work alongside the data platform team; support internal and external analytics and BI

About the role:

Salary range: $192K - $246K*

We are looking for smart engineers who love to code, seek challenging problems and appreciate recognition for excellent work. As part of the Core UX team, you will focus on refining existing product functionality to deliver an exceptional user experience. Your work will center on ensuring consistency across the product, maintaining a cohesive look and feel, and implementing performance improvements that directly impact end users. You’ll be paying close attention to the layout, interactions, responsiveness, and visual polish, that collectively give the product a premium, well-crafted feel. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys iterative improvement, cares deeply about quality, and wants to shape the everyday experience of our users.

You'll collaborate with a global team of full-stack, data, ML, and DevOps engineers to build scalable solutions as we continue to grow. We're a small team where individual contributions have an outsized impact on both our technology and our business.

You'll be right at home if you:
Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with a track record of improving and polishing functionalities to bring premium user experience.
Embody hustle and grit, you're excellent at your craft and relentless in pursuing it.

Role Overview

As a Recruiting Operations Specialist at Labelbox, you’ll help keep hiring running smoothly while delivering an exceptional experience for candidates and interview teams. A large portion of your time will focus on interview scheduling and coordination, partnering closely with the Talent Acquisition leads and hiring managers to manage logistics and keep the process moving. You’ll also manage recruiting workflows and data in Greenhouse and Gem, building reports and dashboards that turn recruiting activity into actionable insights. About the job
About the role:

Salary range: $85K - $135K USD*

Location: USA (Remote)

Kalepa is looking for an exceptional Technical Support Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in B2B SaaS technical support, customer-facing engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role to be a critical member of our Support organization. This role is designed to own the technical investigation and resolution of issues across Kalepa's AI platform for insurance.

You'll be the connective tissue between our customers and our development teams, triaging and investigating complex technical issues, driving resolutions, and building the systems and processes that make our support function world-class. You'll work directly with large-scale enterprise clients who rely on Kalepa's platform to make critical decisions, so your ability to earn trust, communicate clearly under pressure, and go deep on technical problems is critical.

What you'll do:

Technical Investigation & Resolution

Investigate reported issues end to end within Kalepa’s AI underwriting platform. Coordinate technical resolution end-to-end.
Distinguish working-as-expected behavior from genuine bugs, configuration issues, user education gaps, and feature requests.
Manage your own queue and hit response and resolution targets consistently.

Client Communication

Draft responses to Kalepa’s clients that are clear, accurate, and resolve the issue without unnecessary back and forth.
Maintain professional, consistent communication across all client touchpoints.

Engineering & Cross-Functional Coordination

File Jira tickets with full diagnostic context when issues are confirmed bugs, so Engineering has what they need to resolve quickly.
Identify patterns across tickets and surface them to Client Success and Product as themes worth addressing structurally.

Product & Subject Matter Expertise

Become an expert user of Kalepa, with deep familiarity across workflows, edge cases, and product behavior. Build and maintain per-client implementation knowledge.
About you:
Experience at a high-growth tech startup.
You have 3-5 years of experience in a Technical Support Engineer, Senior Technical Solutions Specialist, or similar customer-facing technical role at a B2B SaaS company.
You communicate clearly in writing. You can explain technical issues to non-technical audiences and write responses that hold up under scrutiny from sophisticated users.
You are comfortable operating in ambiguity. Many of the issues you will own do not have a documented answer, and the right resolution requires synthesizing product behavior, client context, and operational judgment.
You are operationally disciplined. You manage your own queue, hit response targets consistently, and do not let things age.
You are metrics-driven, with a strong ability to combine quantitative and qualitative insights.
You value open, direct, and respectful communication.
You enjoy being part of a collaborative, thoughtful, and purpose-driven environment.
Experience supporting complex data-heavy SaaS products
As a plus:
Insurtech or Fintech product experience.
What you’ll get
Competitive salary (based on experience level).
Significant equity options package.
401(k) plan with employer match (regardless of employee contribution)
Excellent benefits: 100% covered medical, 100% covered vision and dental for individuals and families, and others
Work with an ambitious, smart, global, and fun team to transform a $1T global industry.
20 days of PTO a year
Global team offsites (2021 - Playa del Carmen, 2022 - Rome, 2023 - Buenos Aires, 2024 - Lisbon, 2025 - Cartagena)
Healthy living/gym stipend. Mobile phone bill stipend.
Continuing education credits.

**The salary range listed is an estimate and will vary based on a variety of factors. Final compensation will be determined during the offer stage based on relevant experience, performance during the interview process, and geographic location, and may therefore differ from the posted range. *

About the job

Full-time, remote location in any of the following states: MA, NY, CA, TX, CO, IL, OR, WA, CT, NV, NC, SC, TN

Molten Cloud empowers creators and rights-holders of media content through technological innovation. The Molten Cloud platform transforms and simplifies today's complex intellectual property rights, content and licensing operations. The platform is used by media organizations to manage over 175M film/TV rights, hosting data and content for over 10% of all movies known to exist.

Founded in the heart of MIT, Molten Cloud is committed to breaking the barriers that hold digital creativity and media experiences back today. We are a diverse team of hackers, hustlers, and hipsters, and are backed by leading media-tech investors and advisors such as Jack Dorsey and Ashton Kutcher.

As a Support Engineer at Molten, you're the technical backbone of our client experience. You'll report to the Director of Customer Experience and work closely with our Technical Account Managers, Product and Engineering teams. You'll own client requests from first ticket to final response. Day to day, that looks like:

Support queue: you'll own tickets in Zendesk end to end - triaging by priority and impact, answering how-to questions, and troubleshooting platform issues. When something needs a fix, you'll log it in Jira with clear, reproducible steps, escalate to Product and Engineering, and keep the client updated until it's resolved.
Content delivery and downloads: you'll handle client delivery and download requests, making sure films, trailers and other assets reach the right destination in the right format and on time. Data ingestion and implementation support: you'll prepare and load client data - rights, contracts, metadata and content - for new implementations and ongoing ingestion requests, review it against the client's requirements, and check it with SQL queries before it goes live.
Scripting and automation: you'll write and run Python scripts for backend operations like data migrations and bulk updates, and help automate repetitive delivery and ingestion work so the team can scale.
Documentation: you'll document as you go - ticket notes in Jira before anything goes back to the client, and solutions and product knowledge in our Confluence knowledge base so the whole team benefits.
Voice of the customer: you'll be close to what clients struggle with every day, and you'll flag patterns, recurring issues and feature gaps to Product so they shape the roadmap. Systems: you'll be comfortable on the Linux command line, working with cloud storage and large file transfers, and at home in a Windows environment too.

Tools you'll use: Zendesk, Jira, Loom, Confluence, Chorus and Salesforce.

As an ideal fit for this role, you are accountable, analytical, organized and client-focused.

Accountable: you take ownership of your work and see it through. You flag problems early, and when something you own goes wrong, you own the fix too. You collaborate with your teammates, draw on their complementary skill sets, and pick up the skills you need to get the job done.
Analytical and organized: you're comfortable with data and complexity, and no detail is too small for you. When priorities shift or things get busy, you keep perspective, prioritize your own workload and deliver results.
Client-focused communicator: you're clear and calm with clients, including frustrated ones. You explain technical issues in plain language and set honest expectations on timing.

Our culture is about being rigorous at work and celebrating our big and small wins as a team. At Molten, you will have the opportunity to own and lead your own workstreams, learn from exceptional individuals on the team, and help build technology that matters across the world. Everyone on the team primarily works remotely, and the company reimburses purchases for laptops and other office supplies. Benefits include health, vision and dental insurance, but most importantly – a group of exceptional individuals building industry-defining tech.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer to join our growing team at Cyberhaven. In this role, you will drive go-to-market initiatives by leading prospect engagements, including demos and proofs of concept. You will be part of a collaborative and supportive team that is always ready to assist one another. We serve as advisors in data protection, addressing the challenges organizations encounter. Our team thrives on tinkering, building, and developing solutions for emerging challenges. We are experts in industry advancements, competitive threats, and adjacent market technologies.

What you’ll do

Support the Enterprise Sales teams with opportunities in a pre-sales capacity from qualification through production hand-off. Generally, these accounts have more than 2,500 employees.
Learn, create, and deliver compelling messaging and demonstrations of products and solutions that differentiate from competitors or legacy solutions, including how the platform secures data and AI use across the enterprise.
Demonstrate multiple products within the platform in a single narrative, showing how they work together to solve complex business problems.
Guide technical evaluations via POC ownership and manage the evaluation process to a successful conclusion.
Advise customers on securing AI adoption, including emerging agentic AI use cases, and translate their risks into clear technical and business outcomes.
Maintain key partner technical relationships and effectively enable and demonstrate channel partners to excel in a channel-driven sales model.
Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams on new feature releases and provide feedback on current feature capabilities based on field experience/input.

Who you are

4+ years experience as a Sales Engineer (or similar), i.e. complex pre-sales and/or deployment of complex enterprise solutions, especially in a SaaS sales environment
4+ years experience with data protection and AI security solutions (DLP, IRM, DSPM, CASB, AI-Security)
Proven ability to demo and run POCs across multiple products within a single platform, tying them together to solve complex, cross-functional business problems
Current knowledge of Agentic AI architecture (e.g., agents, tool use, MCP, autonomous workflows) and how to secure it
4+ years experience with a cross-platform endpoint agent solution (Windows, Mac, and/or Linux)
Ability to travel to cover events and conferences
Strong sales presence and superior communication skills
Proven ability to multitask and prioritize under pressure
Ability to problem-solve, both independently and as part of a team
Must be located in the following states to support our customers. (Illinois, Wisconsin, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Texas, Oklahoma, Luisiana, Arkansas)

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

AI Tools Disclosure: As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

About the job
About Green

Green is building a global consumer neobank. We're merging international banking and payments into a single product. Our mission is to enable all of our customers around the world to spend, save and earn in USD. We'll be starting the US and select international markets with ambitions to scale far beyond.

Green is built by a small group of highly experienced operators and engineers. We're a small, senior-only team, with no layers, politics, or slow decisions. We've built, founded, and owned services used by hundreds of millions of people and generating billions in revenue. Green is the next step and mass distribution is readily available via our day-one partners. Every person on the team ships product and shapes the direction of the company.

The Role

As a founding Data & Operations Engineer on our small, senior-only team, you will be defining and working on the core systems and workflows that feed data across our internal architecture and beyond. Your architecture and processes will ultimately:

Allow your fellow engineers to aggregate critical product data and platform telemetry into a unified analytics platform.
Enable our FinOps team to ensure consistent, reliable ledgers across a number of financial partners and accounts.
Empower our Fraud / AML (Anti-Money Laundering) team to build high-quality risk models and workflows by shipping clean, understandable data models into our internal decisioning platform.

With our day-one distribution partners, team of highly experienced operators and engineers, and solid financial backing, we are excited to launch and looking for more like-minded engineers to bring Green to the world.

What You'll Do
Use your expert knowledge in Terraform, dbt, and AWS products to ensure data and applications alike are built on a solid, robust foundation

Define safe and secure Least Access patterns that allow man and machine alike to get the data they need when they need it, preserving data lineage and ensuring data governance as part of the regulatory and compliance ecosystem we adhere to

Document and educate the rest of the engineering team in the care and feeding of high-quality infrastructure systems that will support our global user base
What We Value
Ownership: You work deliberately and completely to provide appropriately scoped solutions to the issues we face as a growing FinTech organization

Collaboration: We communicate freely and openly to make sure both code and company are at the level we want it to be

Motivation: You have the experience and self-management to set goals and expectations that align with the rest of the team to reliably ship product and shape the company everyday
What You Bring
Extensive hands-on experience building scalable data architectures in a consumer-oriented FinTech environment using Terraform, dbt, and SQL

Expert-level knowledge of data-centric development patterns for writing and validating various flavors of code deployed across internal and hosted environments alike

Fluent technical communication, especially written, for AI and non-SME consumption
Nice to Have
Data visualization and storytelling techniques

Deep expertise with full-stack applications / machine learning

Specific experience with global payments, ledgering, and other user-facing FinTech applications
What We Offer
$200K-$400K cash compensation
Day 1 impact on partner products used by millions globally

Shape technical vision and architecture as we scale

Own major parts of the product and infrastructure
Ship fast and avoid corporate overhead

About the job

About Perflo

AI agents are starting to do real work for people and businesses: booking, buying, hiring, paying. To do that, they need to handle money, and today’s financial system was built for humans clicking buttons, not for software acting on someone’s behalf.

Perflo is an AI company building the secure wallet for AI agents. We give agents safe, controlled access to money, with spending limits and approval rules their owners set, so people and businesses can trust their agents to transact. Perflo works inside the AI tools people already use, and we’re building the infrastructure that will connect AI agents to the global financial system.
Our founding team comes from Coinbase, Circle, and Transak, so we’ve built global payments infrastructure before. We’re backed by Village Global.

The role
You’ll be our first sales hire. You’ll work directly with the founders to turn early demand into a repeatable sales engine. The job is mostly closing deals, plus telling Perflo’s story in public on X and elsewhere. If you want a defined territory and a finished playbook, this isn’t it. If you want to help define how agents pay for things, read on.

What you’ll do
• Own the full sales cycle with agent builders, AI platforms, and businesses automating payouts and payments: prospecting, discovery, demos, negotiation, close
• Build pipeline through outbound, your network, events, and inbound from our developer community
• Write regularly on X and LinkedIn about Perflo, our launches, customer wins, and where agentic payments are headed
• Shape pricing, positioning, and the playbook every future rep will use
• Bring what you hear from customers back to product and engineering
• Represent Perflo at hackathons, conferences, and founder dinners in NYC and SF

What we’re looking for
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience, with a track record of closing deals you can walk us through
• Fintech or payments background preferred
• Entrepreneurial: you move fast, handle ambiguity well, and don’t wait to be told what to do
• Comfortable learning a technical product well enough to demo it yourself
• A clear writer who enjoys posting, especially on X
• Genuinely excited about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and have opinions on where they’re going

Nice to have
• Experience at an early-stage startup
• Crypto or stablecoin experience
• A following or network in fintech, AI, or developer communities

What we offer
• $140K–$180K base, plus commission and meaningful equity
• A real path to leading sales as the team grows
• A seat at the table at the start of a new category

How to apply
Send your LinkedIn, your X handle, and a few lines about a deal you’re proud of to tracy@perflo.ai
